title: Practice 1: Verbs that take the instrumental

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Я любовался ___ (работа) Тома.
exercises.why: «любоваться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Enjoy yourself at the party, John.
exercises.why: «наслаждаться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том владеет ___ (фиктивная компания) на Британских Виргинских островах.
exercises.prompt: Tom owns a shell company in the British Virgin Islands.
exercises.why: «владеть» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Why were you waving a flag?
exercises.why: «махать» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: We can't keep on fooling ourselves.
